world.name: Vespormoor
world.description: A secluded gothic mountain university town where modern life, old families, and human-presenting Veiled residents meet around the dark waters of Lake Vesper.

locations.name: Afterdark Diner
locations.description: A twenty-four-hour diner where almost every social circle in Vespormoor eventually crosses paths.

locations.name: Anatomy Hall
locations.description: A prestigious medical school containing old surgical theaters and some very unusual specimens.

locations.name: Belladonna Apothecary
locations.description: An herbalist and apothecary serving humans as well as customers with more unusual medical needs.

locations.name: The Black Lantern
locations.description: A candlelit pub inside a former coaching inn and one of Vespormoor's oldest social institutions.

locations.name: Black Veil Tattoo
locations.description: A tattoo and piercing studio specializing in unusual inks, sigils, and occult designs.

locations.name: Blackglass Library
locations.description: A towering multi-level library containing one of the world's greatest collections of historical and supernatural material.

locations.name: Blackwood Dormitories
locations.description: Atmospheric student residences occupying former guest and servant wings of the castle.

locations.name: Blackwood Estate
locations.description: An immaculate mansion belonging to one of the Covenant's most influential families.

locations.name: The Crimson Room
locations.description: An exclusive members-only lounge popular with old families, artists, and discreet Veiled residents.

locations.name: The Crooked Oak
locations.description: A rustic tavern and restaurant frequented by locals, hikers, rangers, and forest workers.

locations.name: Dead Letter
locations.description: An underground live-music venue for alternative, metal, electronic, and experimental acts.

locations.name: The Drowned Bell
locations.description: An old waterfront tavern popular with boat crews, students, locals, and discreet Veiled regulars.

locations.name: Foxglove Cabin Retreats
locations.description: Beautiful secluded cabins scattered through the forest.

locations.name: Glasswater Pier
locations.description: A long public pier extending into Lake Vesper.

locations.name: The Grand Hall
locations.description: An enormous vaulted gathering hall used for ceremonies, dinners, dances, and major university events.

locations.name: Hawthorne Riding Club
locations.description: A historic equestrian estate with stables, riding trails, and a wealthy social scene.

locations.name: The High Gardens
locations.description: Vast terraced gardens with fountains, hedge mazes, glasshouses, secluded benches, and cliffside overlooks.

locations.name: Lakeward
locations.description: Restaurants, docks, old cottages, walking paths, and fog-covered water give Lakeward some of Vespormoor's most romantic scenery.

locations.name: Moonstone Quarry
locations.description: An abandoned quarry containing flooded tunnels and unusual pale stone.

locations.name: Moonwake Baths
locations.description: A restored Victorian bathhouse turned luxurious lakeside spa.

locations.name: Morrow & Quill
locations.description: A huge independent bookstore filled with fireplaces, ladders, forgotten rooms, and rare books.

locations.name: Morrow Vale Ranger Station
locations.description: A remote ranger outpost responsible for incidents officials usually describe as wildlife encounters.

locations.name: The Mourning Cup
locations.description: A cozy café famous for pastries, dark coffee, rain-covered windows, and lingering conversations.

locations.name: Nocturne
locations.description: Vespormoor's premier nightclub inside a converted nineteenth-century performance hall.

locations.name: The Observatory
locations.description: A remote domed observatory above the estate, popular for astronomy classes and late-night dates.

locations.name: Old Vesper
locations.description: The oldest part of town: narrow cobblestone streets, gothic storefronts, gas lamps, hidden courtyards, and centuries-old businesses.

locations.name: Raven Ward
locations.description: The younger and more dangerous side of Vespormoor, filled with clubs, converted warehouses, underground venues, tattoo studios, and businesses that thrive after midnight.

locations.name: The Red Market
locations.description: A hidden nighttime marketplace for rare ingredients, warded objects, information, and discreet services.

locations.name: Rookery House
locations.description: A busy student café and pub inside an old gatehouse.

locations.name: Rosegrave Gardens
locations.description: A public botanical estate famous for strange black roses and secluded paths.

locations.name: Saint Mercy Hotel
locations.description: A decadent old boutique hotel with a cocktail bar downstairs and a reputation for absolute discretion.

locations.name: Saint Orison Chapel
locations.description: A small gothic church with an ancient crypt beneath it.

locations.name: The Standing Stones
locations.description: An ancient stone circle still used for supernatural rituals.

locations.name: Stillwater House
locations.description: An upscale restaurant with enormous windows looking directly across the lake.

locations.name: The Sunken Chapel
locations.description: A ruined stone structure beneath the lake that becomes partially visible when water levels fall.

locations.name: The Cloisters
locations.description: Covered gothic walkways surrounding a beautiful secluded courtyard garden.

locations.name: The Conservatory
locations.description: An elegant glasshouse restaurant overlooking the lights of Vespormoor.

locations.name: Thornwood
locations.description: Beyond the populated valley lie enormous forests, isolated cabins, waterfalls, ruins, and places that existed long before Vespormoor.

locations.name: Thornwood Trailhead
locations.description: The main entrance to the extensive network of mountain and forest trails.

locations.name: The Undercroft
locations.description: Ancient tunnels, crypts, forgotten rooms, and sealed passages beneath the castle.

locations.name: Vale House
locations.description: A long-abandoned mansion recently occupied again under mysterious circumstances.

locations.name: Velvet Thorn
locations.description: An intimate late-night cocktail lounge hidden behind an unmarked entrance.

locations.name: Vesper Boatworks
locations.description: A historic marina offering rowboats, sailboats, and lake excursions.

locations.name: Vesper Heights
locations.description: Wooded hills filled with enormous homes belonging to Vespormoor's wealthiest and oldest families.

locations.name: Vesper Heights Overlook
locations.description: A stone lookout providing one of the best views over the town and lake.

locations.name: Vesper House
locations.description: The supposedly abandoned ancestral home of Lucien and Isolde Vesper, where lights have recently appeared inside again.

locations.name: Vesper Square
locations.description: Central town plaza with an old fountain, markets, festivals, and outdoor gathering spaces.

locations.name: Vesper Tower
locations.description: The highest tower on campus, providing a panoramic view of Vespormoor and Lake Vesper.

locations.name: Vespormoor University
locations.description: A colossal gothic castle-estate occupying the ridge above Vespormoor, with towers, bridges, gardens, courtyards, dormitories, and academic wings visible from almost anywhere in town.

locations.name: Whisper Dock
locations.description: A remote wooden dock traditionally used by couples to confess things they cannot say elsewhere.

locations.name: Witch's Falls
locations.description: A dramatic waterfall cascading into a deep natural swimming hole.

characters.name: Adelaide Hawthorne
characters.biography: A candid riding trainer whose heightened senses make crowds exhausting and wilderness honesty irresistible.

characters.name: Adrian Bell
characters.biography: A charming, grounded bartender who observes more than he gossips and knows the shape of decades-old local stories.

characters.name: Amara Nwosu
characters.biography: A warm cabin-retreat owner whose hospitality is generous but never an invitation to ignore her privacy.

characters.name: Astrid Nygaard
characters.biography: A quietly intense researcher whose intuition predicts patterns before her instruments can explain them.

characters.name: Callum Reid
characters.biography: A steady senior ranger who has spent years translating impossible incidents into reports outsiders will accept.

characters.name: Camille Laurent
characters.biography: A disciplined chef whose warmth appears in food long before she trusts someone with it in words.

characters.name: Dr. Celeste Moreau
characters.biography: A brilliant folklore professor who treats legends as evidence without confusing a compelling story for proof.

characters.name: Clara Whitmore
characters.biography: A grounded, sarcastic café owner who came to Vespormoor on a visit and somehow never found a convincing reason to leave.

characters.name: Dahlia Kane
characters.biography: A magnetic resident DJ who controls a room without confusing attention for intimacy.

characters.name: Dorian Bellamy
characters.biography: A charismatic literature student who jokes fluently but becomes exact when a conversation stops being safe to hide inside.
characters.occupation: Literature Student and Rookery House Bartender

characters.name: Elara Vale
characters.biography: An enigmatic new resident of Vale House who is more direct about desire than she is about where she came from.
characters.occupation: Vale House Resident and Independent Researcher

characters.name: Elodie Marchand
characters.biography: A stylish art-history student who is socially fearless but privately uncertain whether anyone sees beyond her presentation.

characters.name: Evelyn Harrow
characters.biography: A thoughtful bookseller with gentle intelligence and dry humor who knows local history without performing it for visitors.

characters.name: Freya Lind
characters.biography: An independent photographer who came for one autumn assignment and became fascinated by what the camera refuses to hold.

characters.name: Dr. Gideon Price
characters.biography: A seasoned clinical lecturer whose reassuring authority, dry warmth, and carefully protected personal life make his full attention feel unusually intimate.

characters.name: Hana Watanabe
characters.biography: A calm history student with a faint psychometric gift who prefers evidence to the dramatic stories objects try to tell her.
characters.occupation: History Student and Grand Hall Pianist

characters.name: Hannah Mercer
characters.biography: A quick-witted bartender balancing affection for her hometown with a determination not to inherit everyone else's expectations.

characters.name: Isabella Reyes
characters.biography: A meticulous archivist with a sly sense of humor who believes access should be earned by care, not inherited status.

characters.name: Julian Ashcroft
characters.biography: A controlled estate attorney fluent in leverage, discretion, and the dangerous difference between a rule and its purpose.

characters.name: Jun Park
characters.biography: A skeptical limnologist whose scientific discipline is being tested by data that refuses to remain physically possible.

characters.name: Katya Morozova
characters.biography: A formidable lounge manager whose impeccable discretion hides a blunt, surprisingly funny private self.

characters.name: Keira Sullivan
characters.biography: A perceptive first-year psychology student determined not to become the unofficial therapist for everyone she meets.
characters.occupation: Psychology Student and Rookery House Barista

characters.name: Lena Kovács
characters.biography: A restless vocalist whose stage confidence disappears into sharp self-awareness when a song becomes personal.

characters.name: Lina Moreno
characters.biography: A serious first-year architecture student who becomes animated the moment a building stops making structural sense.

characters.name: Luca Ferraro
characters.biography: A polished hotel manager whose charm is professional until he chooses, very clearly, for it not to be.

characters.name: Lyra Vane
characters.biography: A magnetic musician whose connection to the lake is easier to hear in her songs than to make her explain.

characters.name: Maeve Kearney
characters.biography: An earthy botany student whose curiosity is much bolder around plants than people.
characters.occupation: Botany Student and Rookery House Server

characters.name: Marcus Reed
characters.biography: A calm rare-book restorer whose empathy makes him careful with other people's emotional boundaries.

characters.name: Marina Costa
characters.biography: A capable sailing instructor who treats fear as information, not weakness, and refuses to romanticize unsafe choices.

characters.name: Mateo Serrano
characters.biography: A warm veterinarian whose calm around animals contrasts with a lively, openly affectionate social side.

characters.name: Maya Bennett
characters.biography: An ambitious medical student with lively humor who is trying not to let competence become her entire personality.

characters.name: Mirelle Voss
characters.biography: The elegant and provocative proprietor of Velvet Thorn, patient enough to let silence reveal what people intended to hide.

characters.name: Naomi Okafor
characters.biography: A decisive architect who loves old buildings without romanticizing the power structures that built them.

characters.name: Nia Holloway
characters.biography: A bold tattoo artist whose sigil work is subtle enough to pass as design and personal enough never to be copied casually.

characters.name: Owen Mercer
characters.biography: A reserved pianist whose humor is warmer than his stage persona and whose music shifts with the lake's moods.

characters.name: Priya Raman
characters.biography: A warm, practical herbalist whose teasing competence makes difficult things feel manageable.

characters.name: Rafael Ortega
characters.biography: A practical physics student whose electrical affinity makes him excellent with instruments and deeply suspicious of mystical explanations.

characters.name: Ren Takahashi
characters.biography: A composed conservation engineer who reads old buildings with technical rigor while hiding how literally some walls leave impressions in his hands.

characters.name: Rowan Hale
characters.biography: A watchful Morrow Vale ranger whose heightened senses make her exceptional in the forest and cautious in crowded rooms. Direct, protective, and dryly funny, Rowan trusts changes in the woods before she trusts easy explanations.

characters.name: Roxanne “Roxy” Bell
characters.biography: A quick, sensual night waitress who knows every social circle's after-hours version and protects confidences beneath relentless humor.

characters.name: Selene Morcant
characters.biography: A poised spa director who understands bodies, privacy, and the difference between relaxation and avoidance.

characters.name: Seraphine Orison
characters.biography: A serene chapel caretaker whose compassion feels contemporary even when her knowledge of the building does not.

characters.name: Sofia Alvarez
characters.biography: A pragmatic geologist who came for anomalous stone and stayed because every explanation creates a better question.

characters.name: Tomás Ferreira
characters.biography: A daring rescue diver whose confidence is backed by preparation rather than a death wish.

characters.name: Vivienne Blackwood
characters.biography: A polished old-family heir who understands power intimately and resents being treated as if inheritance erased her own ambition.
characters.occupation: Blackwood Estate Heiress and Foundation Director

characters.name: Willow Thorne
characters.biography: A quietly sensual cook whose affinity with plants is practical, intimate, and impossible to reduce to a party trick.

characters.name: Zuri Campbell
characters.biography: A bright astronomy student who treats wonder as a discipline and flirting as a game she intends to win fairly.
